archetype: Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) - Customized for Dark Mode Fleet Command Center

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align forms, dense data, and tabular content. Ensure optical alignment.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all font-medium border border-blue-500/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#252525] text-white border border-white/10 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-white/5 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all

components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs. Inactive text-zinc-500, Active text-white with border-b-2 border-blue-600. Avoid pill-shaped tabs; stick to technical underline styles.
components.cards: Go flat and rectangular. Use `border-white/10` with `#141414` background. Do not use soft shadows; use 1px solid strokes or inner glows.
components.inputs: Shadcn components customized: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-md.
components.badges: Technical look. Example for 'On the Road': bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20 rounded-sm px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive cards: translate-y-[-2px] with border-white/30 and subtle drop shadow.
motion_and_interactions.forms: Inputs and dropdowns should have a distinct focus state (blue ring) to maintain accessibility.

dashboard_header_bg.description: Sleek abstract dark technology background with subtle blue glowing accents. Use in the dashboard header or hero section.

car_damage_sample.description: Sample image of a damaged car fender, to be used in the Damage view/upload component.

fleet_cars.description: A row of parked cars in a garage, suitable for the 'Vehicles' tab header or empty state background.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use zinc-400 for secondary text to maintain readability on dark backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="vehicle-tab"`, `data-testid="submit-handover-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The project uses JavaScript (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Generate all components as .jsx/.js files.
Enforce dark mode globally: the UI must have a black background (#0A0A0A), white text (#FFFFFF), and blue accents (#2563EB) per user request.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Tabs, Cards, Table, Dialog/Modal, Select, Checkbox). Customize them to remove Vercel defaults and match the 'Performance Pro' technical dark mode aesthetic.
Dashboard Page: Display 4 key metric cards (Total Vehicles, On the Road, Damaged, Needs Maintenance) using a 4-column grid (`grid-cols-4`).
Vehicles Tab: Create a CRUD interface (Data Table) with columns: Brand, Model, License Plate (use monospace font), Status, Mileage.
Damages Section: Provide a view to upload/take pictures of damage (use `car_damage_sample` image as placeholder/preview), link to a vehicle, and a checkbox for 'Tolerated' vs 'Not Tolerated' damage.
Maintenance Tab: UI for scheduling recurring maintenance by mileage or month, clearing notifications, and a history log.

Protocols Tab - Handover: Implement a form with a vehicle dropdown, fuel level slider/input, extras checklist (medkit, etc.), mileage input, name, and a signature pad (use `react-signature-canvas` or similar). Submitting this must change the vehicle status to 'On the Road'.
Protocols Tab - History: Show a list of handover protocols. Provide a way to handle 'Return'. Returning a vehicle marks the protocol row in green and changes the vehicle status to 'Parked'.
